description: This file defines the SNComponent class, which extends DecryptedItem to represent a component used within the application. It includes methods and properties for handling component URLs, permissions, activation status, and other metadata, primarily for iframe-based extensions communication.

classes.name: SNComponent
classes.description: Represents a component item, typically iframe-based, with properties for URLs, permissions, activation status, and methods for conflict resolution, type checks, and data retrieval.

methods.name: strategyWhenConflictingWithItem
methods.description: Determines conflict resolution strategy when conflicting with another item.

methods.name: isEditor
methods.description: Checks if the component is an editor type.

methods.name: isTheme
methods.description: Checks if the component is a theme.

methods.name: legacyIsDefaultEditor
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if component is the default editor, based on application preferences.

methods.name: getLastSize
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored size of the component.

methods.name: getClientDataKey
methods.description: Returns the key for accessing data stored on the component, based on URL or UUID.

methods.name: hasValidHostedUrl
methods.description: Checks if the component has a valid hosted URL.

methods.name: contentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Returns keys to ignore when checking equality of content objects.

methods.name: associativeAreas
methods.description: Static method returning areas where components are considered associative.

methods.name: isAssociative
methods.description: Checks if the component is associative based on its area.

methods.name: isExplicitlyEnabledForItem
methods.description: Checks if the component is explicitly enabled for a specific item UUID.

methods.name: isExplicitlyDisabledForItem
methods.description: Checks if the component is explicitly disabled for a specific item UUID.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines if the component's valid_until date has passed.

methods.name: identifier
methods.description: Returns the feature identifier for the component.

methods.name: thirdPartyPackageInfo
methods.description: Returns third-party package information for the component.

methods.name: noteType
methods.description: Returns the note type associated with the component.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks whether the component is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: deprecationMessage
methods.description: Provides the deprecation message if any.

ctags.name: SNComponent
ctags.pattern: /^export class SNComponent extends DecryptedItem<ComponentContent> implements ComponentInterface {$/

ctags.name: isComponent
ctags.pattern: /^export const isComponent = (x: ItemInterface): x is SNComponent => x.content_type === ContentTyp/

ctags.name: isComponentOrTheme
ctags.pattern: /^export const isComponentOrTheme = (x: ItemInterface): x is SNComponent =>$/
